# Data and downloads

All 35 numbered supplementary tables are supplied in one [CSV archive](../downloads/supplementary_tables.zip), together with a [SHA-256 manifest](../downloads/table_manifest.csv) and a [figure-to-table map](../downloads/figure_data_map.csv). Numerical values and machine identifiers match manuscript revision 14.

For command-line extraction and checksum verification, use `python3 reproduction/reproduce.py tables`. The output has one file per supplementary table. The input archive is about 36 MB compressed and expands to about 166 MB.

## Download code and benchmark assets

- [Tutorial scripts](../downloads/tutorial_scripts.zip): the four example parts and their runner.
- [Reproduction scripts](../downloads/reproduction_scripts.zip): paper plotting and checks, brain-study entry points and source engines. Retain the directory layout when copying these into the repository.
- [Independent eQTL benchmark](../downloads/independent_LD_benchmark.tar.gz): frozen inputs, exact CDSeq2 source snapshot, code, environment capture and completed results. About 20 MB compressed.

The benchmark contains aggregate training-derived parameters and a public haplotype reference, not the original individual-level brain-study expression matrices. The original brain-data branch needs the additional inputs described in [its chapter](brain-benchmarks.qmd). The tutorial uses wholly synthetic data.

## Reading the tables

The reader-facing text uses full cell-type names. For compatibility, CSVs preserve original codes: `Excit` = excitatory neurons; `Inhib` = inhibitory neurons; `Astro` = astrocytes; `Oligo` = oligodendrocytes; `OPC` = oligodendrocyte precursor cells; `Immune` = immune cells; `Vascular` = vascular cells. Archived workflow labels such as `CDSeq2+GAM6` refer to CDSeq2 (with gene-type prioritization).

The table names indicate their level: per-profile, per-test, per-donor example, per-replicate or summary. Undefined values are not zeros. See the figure captions for the exact selection universe and denominator. The independent benchmark also includes `TABLE_SCHEMA.txt` for Tables S26–S35.
